name: Stories of Mara
source:
Dive into the charming Stories of Mara, an episodic slice of life tale about a diverse cast of characters. Get to know your neighbours and bond with them, but… Could you make them stick together to help each other? 

Explore the everyday life in Mara through unique tales in this slice of life visual novel. Step into the shoes of a diverse cast and get to know the struggles and desires of the inhabitants of this modern-fantasy world set in a tropical archipelago.

Mara is the ocean that brings life to our shores. After the elits, an evil alien corporation, attacked our planet, life is healing and everything got back to normal. But in Qälis, the city island in Mara, normal is just a word.

You will follow Akaji, a procrastinating blacksmith who has to ask for the help of all her neighbors to find Koa, who has disappeared, while dealing with her own struggles. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1647780/]Steam[/url]]

Sequel of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/962580/]Summer of Mara[/url], an adventure/farming game
translation:
深入了解迷人的玛拉故事，这是一个关于不同角色的生活故事片段。了解你的邻居并与他们建立联系，但是……你能让他们团结在一起互相帮助吗？

通过这部生活片段视觉小说中的独特故事，探索马拉的日常生活。扮演不同演员的角色，了解这个以热带群岛为背景的现代奇幻世界中居民的挣扎和欲望。

马拉是为我们的海岸带来生命的海洋。在邪恶的外星集团精英攻击我们的星球后，生活正在愈合，一切都恢复正常。但在马拉的城市岛屿Qälis，“正常”只是一个词。

你将跟随阿卡吉，一个拖延的铁匠，她必须请求所有邻居的帮助才能找到失踪的科阿，同时处理自己的斗争。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1647780/]Steam[/url]]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/962580/]Summer of Mara[/url] 的续集，一款冒险/农业游戏
